description_excerpt: ABOUT YOUR ROLE: The Costing Analyst, working in a country of product manufacturing and co-located with VF product development teams, will be a part of the Costing Management function in the newly formed Product Costing organization at VF Corporation. Will support development costing operations that provide for 100’s of millions of dollars’ worth of product cost across several VF brands and products. The individual will partner closely with other functions in the Costing Organization and product supply teams to ensure process and best practice adherence. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE:…
